description: Sends a Hyperliquid action prepared by /hyperliquid/prepare and signed by the wallet (eth_signTypedData_v4) to the exchange: order, cancel, leverage change or builder-fee approval. Returns the exchange result per order (resting with its id, filled with size and average price, or the rejection reason). The signature is forwarded as-is; no key ever reaches the server. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

action.description: The action object returned by /prepare, unchanged

vault_address.description: Optional vault or sub-account address the action is for
